summary: Frontend-only verification of the 'destroy is not a function' React runtime bug fix across 7 admin/user pages. All pages loaded without runtime errors after fix (useEffect(() => { load(); }, []) instead of useEffect(load, [])). Also validated end-to-end Nova Categoria create flow: modal opens, form saves, toast 'Salvo' appears, and new row shows in table.

issues: Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart container is likely rendering before layout is computed or has 0-sized parent. Cosmetic warning, doesn't break UI, but should be fixed by giving ResponsiveContainer a fixed height or min-height.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate Recharts width/height=-1 warning on /admin dashboard by giving container min-height

(Optional) On first observed run, navigating rapidly across admin pages caused axios 429/401 responses that appeared to trigger the interceptor to invalidate the token and redirect back to /admin/login. When navigating with a small wait between pages the issue disappears. Consider tuning the axios response interceptor so 401 on non-auth endpoints doesn't clear the admin JWT, or handle 429 with backoff instead of logout.
critical_code_review_comments: All 7 useEffect(load, []) call sites have been correctly refactored to useEffect(() => { load(); }, []). Fix verified across AdminCategories, AdminCoupons, AdminPromotions, AdminBanners, AdminTickets, UserSupport, UserOrders.

Pattern is consistent — good. Recommend adding an ESLint rule (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps) if not already enforced to catch this class of bug at lint time. If enforced, would also warn that `load` should be in the dep array or memoized with useCallback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 admin pages load without runtime errors, Nova Categoria create flow OK)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'destroy is not a function' from useEffect(load, []) is fully fixed. All 6 admin pages (/admin, /admin/categorias, /admin/cupons, /admin/promocoes, /admin/banners, /admin/tickets) verified via Playwright to load without pageerrors. /painel/pedidos correctly redirects to /login when unauthenticated (2 expected 401s from API, no destroy error). Nova Categoria full CRUD create flow works end-to-end (modal → fill → Salvar → toast Salvo → row appears in table). If you re-run navigation-heavy Playwright suites, add small waits between page.goto calls (~2s) to avoid axios interceptor logging user out on 429 rate limits — this is a separate side observation, not a bug introduced by this fix.
rca of the issue: React 18 useEffect requires the effect callback to return either undefined or a cleanup function. Passing an async function directly (useEffect(load, []) where `load` is async) makes React receive a Promise as the return value. On unmount, React calls the returned value as if it were a cleanup function, producing 'TypeError: destroy is not a function' (React calls `destroy()` on the returned value). Fix: wrap the async call in a synchronous IIFE or arrow function that does not return the promise: useEffect(() => { load(); }, []). Applied and verified across all 7 files. Reproduction: navigate to /admin/categorias with the old code, unmount by clicking a sidebar link — TypeError fires in React's commit phase.
